itemdesc-emberheart: A sealed clay-and-wax pellet packed with iron filings, salt and charcoal. Crack it open and it burns warm for hours.
itemdesc-emberheartshell: A burnt-out clay shell, still smelling of sulfur. Crush or recombine it to reclaim the clay.
itemdesc-emberheartpowder: A grey-black blend of ground iron, salt and charcoal. It wants only a spark and something to hold it.
